boundary: Exact frozen alpha sealed Hub+full member factories, production AD driver over synthetic TLS/BER LDAPS and actual browser sessions/Settings confirmations. Representative input handoff and model answer are simulated at explicit callbacks; actual consent, admission, journal, lease/release and WSS. No daemon IPC, real model, native CLI/account/live fleet or tmux.
